calibration_note: Pass05 baseline starts from locally selected Pass04 attempt02 data, not the remote Pass04 baseline.
pass_goal: Carry forward Pass04 locally selected controls; address DOWN support/fold, FROG gaze/hand support, FCDN forearm penetration, and preserve DOGG/CLSD gains.

priorities: Assess each pose baseline against prior selected Pass04 visuals; do not score only the newest attempt.
DOWN: actual B palms at floor, B head below hips while face forwards; use shoulder/elbow reach measurement
FROG: world-space B head elevation forward/up, palms on floor, preserve wide feet and no collisions
FCDN: forearms do not penetrate floor, low side-facing head preserved, hands not mandatory load-bearing
DOGG/CLSD: preserve head elevation and contact, improve visual pelvis/hand quality only when evidence supports it
guidance.non_fcdn_head: Face should orient forward and slightly upward, verified from side and three-quarter views; do not blindly trust bone axis.
guidance.fcdn_head: Keep low, sideways face near the floor, no head-up presentation.
guidance.contact: Use palm patch median, coverage and visual review together. A near-zero vertex gap is not convincing contact.
guidance.measurement_only: All geometry and quality scores are references, never gates
guidance.selection_policy: Pick best visual+measured attempt 00, 01, or 02 independently; attempt02 is NEVER automatic winner; document contact/support/gaze regression.

DOGG-DOGG-V00.priority: Preserve prior local selected posture and hand coverage. Improve only verified defects.

DOGG-CLSD-V00.priority: Preserve narrow front-knee stance; do not transform it into DOGG standard.

DOGG-DOWN-V00.priority: Complete forward standing fold and hand support without flipping face backwards.

DOGG-FCDN-V00.priority: Keep low side-facing head. Correct forearm penetration, do not raise head.

DOGG-FROG-V00.priority: Keep wide feet and no leg collision. Head must face forward/up; no knee-floor requirement.

verification_protocol.per_pose: Compare attempt 00 vs attempted 01/02 in matched side and 3/4 camera images; confirm contact distribution, support, head direction, pose silhouette and clipping. A single numeric pass is not a visual guarantee.
verification_protocol.selection: Choose best attempt 00/01/02 individually. Never automatically choose latest attempt.
verification_protocol.evidence: Record actual changed controls, hypothesis, measured improvement and regressions, visual reason, truthful local score.
